strategy.thesis: Zuellig Pharma, Asia's largest pharmaceutical distribution and healthcare-services company (Singapore HQ), runs a Corporate Venture & Partnerships function that invests in and acquires digital-health and clinic/healthcare-IT startups to extend its pharma distribution and patient-access network across Asia.

summary.en: Singapore-headquartered pan-Asian pharmaceutical distribution and healthcare-services company whose Corporate Venture & Partnerships unit invests in and acquires digital-health startups (e.g. Klinify, Sensely) and runs an innovation centre to develop new healthcare technology for the region.

strategy.thesis: JLABS Singapore is Johnson & Johnson Innovation's dedicated life-sciences incubator for the Asia-Pacific region, opened in partnership with Singapore's Economic Development Board (EDB) to help early-stage biotech, medtech and healthcare-solution companies develop discoveries into medicines and medical technologies, with a path to J&J scientific, regulatory, venture and talent resources.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Part of the global JLABS network run by Johnson & Johnson Innovation; companies retain independence (no equity taken for space) but are connected to J&J scientific/regulatory mentorship and, via Johnson & Johnson Innovation - JJDC, potential investment.

summary.en: Johnson & Johnson's life-science incubator JLABS opened its Singapore site in October 2023 in collaboration with Singapore EDB, giving early-stage biotech, medtech and healthcare-solution startups in Southeast Asia access to J&J's scientific, regulatory, mentorship and venture network.

sources.title: J&J inks 'first of its kind' pact with Singapore government to boost regional life sciences innovation
sources.supports: JLABS Singapore launch, EDB partnership, focus on medicines/medtech/healthcare solutions
sources.quote: Johnson & Johnson's incubator—dubbed JLABS—will help early-stage companies in Singapore develop their discoveries into medicines, medical technologies and healthcare solutions.

sources.title: Shaping a Health Innovation Hub: Alessandro Falcone Reflects on JLABS Singapore's Milestone Year and Future Goals
sources.supports: JLABS Singapore operations and local ecosystem partnerships

sources.title: Life Science Incubators And Accelerators @ JLABS

verification_notes: J&J global HQ is New Brunswick, New Jersey, USA; JLABS Singapore is included here as a dedicated regional (APAC) incubator office per slice scope. Exact launch date (Oct 2023) taken from Fierce Biotech reporting.

strategy.thesis: Novartis Biome Singapore is Novartis's first innovation hub for the Asia Pacific, Middle East and Africa region, co-developing digital solutions with external innovators across Novartis's therapeutic, research and business functions, providing access to regulatory/medical/legal expertise and clinical-trial data sandboxes, with investment and financing offered in select cases.

summary.en: Novartis's first Asia-Pacific/Middle East/Africa innovation hub, based in Singapore alongside Novartis's corporate office and manufacturing facility, pairing external digital-health innovators with Novartis therapeutic and research teams and, in some cases, direct investment.

strategy.thesis: Bayer's Innovation Center in Singapore is one of the Pharmaceuticals Division's six global science and innovation hubs, collaborating with regional researchers on oncology and cardiovascular science while Bayer's G4A program provides workspace, mentorship and financial support to digital-health startups.

summary.en: Bayer's Singapore Innovation Center is one of six global Pharmaceuticals Division science hubs, focused on oncology and cardiovascular research for Asia, and hosts Bayer's G4A program which funds and mentors digital-health startups.

sources.supports: Singapore innovation center as one of six Pharma Division hubs; oncology/cardiovascular focus
sources.quote: Bayer's Innovation Center Singapore is one of six science and innovation hubs around the world in the Pharmaceuticals Division, collaborating with researchers in oncology and cardiovascular fields to translate the latest science into targeted medicines for patients in Asia.

sources.title: Healthcare innovation funding for e-health startups | Bayer G4A

sources.quote: over 150 startups having gone through the program

verification_notes: Bayer global HQ is Leverkusen, Germany; included as a dedicated Singapore regional hub per slice scope. G4A is a global program (not Singapore-exclusive); Singapore is confirmed as one of its Asia hub locations.

name.en: MSD IDEA Studio Asia Pacific (MSD Global Health Innovation Fund)

strategy.thesis: MSD IDEA Studio Asia Pacific, based in Singapore, combines MSD's corporate venture arm (the MSD Global Health Innovation Fund) with regional business teams to fund and partner with early-stage and growth companies across Asia-Pacific, with initial focus on improving access to vaccination and cancer therapies.

summary.en: MSD's Global Health Innovation Fund launched its Asia-Pacific IDEA Studio in Singapore in June 2024, combining corporate venture investment with regional business teams to fund and partner with early-stage healthcare companies, with early focus on vaccination access and cancer therapies.

sources.title: MSD Launches IDEA Studios to Fuel Health Care Innovation
sources.supports: IDEA Studio Asia Pacific location (Singapore), combination of corporate venture arm and regional teams, focus areas

strategy.thesis: Duopharma Biotech, one of Malaysia's leading listed pharmaceutical companies, makes strategic and venture-style investments in biosimilar-manufacturing joint ventures and health/biotech-adjacent startups (e.g. DE3PBIO, PanGen biosimilars JV) as part of its growth and innovation strategy.

summary.en: Malaysia's leading listed pharmaceutical company (Bursa Malaysia: DPHARMA), which alongside its biosimilar manufacturing joint ventures has made a handful of direct startup investments, including a planned up-to-US$1M stake in ingredient-tech startup DE3PBIO.

name.en: Roche Startup Creasphere Asia-Pacific / In-Co Hub (Singapore)

strategy.thesis: Roche's global digital-health accelerator Startup Creasphere has been based in Singapore since 2020 as its Asia-Pacific hub, complemented by the newly launched In-Co Hub open-innovation platform connecting Roche with APAC startups, VCs, accelerators and government agencies to scale biomedical innovation.

summary.en: Roche's APAC base for its global Startup Creasphere digital-health accelerator is in Singapore (since 2020, four Singapore-based startups supported), now paired with Roche's newly launched In-Co Hub open-innovation platform for partnering with APAC startups, VCs and government agencies.

sources.supports: In-Co Hub launch, Startup Creasphere APAC base in Singapore since 2020
